stories.headline: Jensen Huang tells Nvidia staff he's in therapy and thanks the White House
body: Huang held Nvidia's first all-hands since his reinstatement on Tuesday.
He apologised and admitted he broke the code of conduct he helped write, CNBC reported.
He thanked the White House for his second chance.
stories.vc: Staff trust matters for keeping top engineers.

stories.headline: Tidal will ban and delete fully AI-generated songs
body: Tidal says more than 43% of uploads in the last 90 days were AI-generated.
It will start removing fully AI-made music on December 9, deleting over 29 million songs by year-end.
Songs made with AI help are still allowed.
stories.vc: Cutting AI spam protects payouts for human artists.

stories.headline: Shadowfax buys Borzo's India unit for same-city deliveries
body: Shadowfax bought the Indian arm of Borzo, formerly WeFast, for ₹23.3 crore.
It gets Shadowfax into on-demand deliveries within cities for small businesses and individuals.
Borzo has over 32,000 delivery partners in five-plus cities.
stories.joke: Same city, same day, new owner.
stories.vc: Logistics firms are racing to own fast local delivery.

stories.headline: Uber and Nuro start driverless tests of Lucid robotaxis
body: Uber and Nuro are testing driverless Lucid Gravity SUVs in the San Francisco Bay Area.
Employees will soon get rides, ahead of a public launch in early 2027.
Uber agreed to buy at least 20,000 Lucid Gravity SUVs over six years.
stories.joke: Look, no hands, and no driver.
stories.vc: A big fleet order gives struggling Lucid steadier revenue.

stories.headline: Tata, Hyundai and Audi raise car prices from December
body: Tata Motors will raise prices by an average of 0.5% from December 1.
Hyundai will raise some models by up to ₹8,000.
Both cite rising input and commodity costs.
stories.joke: December: the month cars get pricier and resolutions get cheaper.
stories.vc: Price hikes may pull some purchases forward into November.
